meta.title: Almost For Ever
meta.description: Live memory index and visual workbench: ranks tags and body text each turn and injects only matching entries. Open “🗂 记忆库” in the corner for a library atlas with cross-library search, reading, section and entry editing, version-conflict protection, and snapshot undo. Model-proposed writes still require sticky-note confirmation. Reads and writes only local memory files and AGENTS.md.
